map.包围曝光张数 使用指南: Bracketed Exposure Frame Count User Guide
map.输入期望的总动态范围与每档曝光步长（如 1 EV、2 EV），工具计算完成 HD: Enter the desired total dynamic range and the per-step exposure increment (such as 1 EV or 2 EV); the tool computes the minimum number of bracketed frames needed to complete an HDR blend and notes that adjacent frames should overlap by at least 1 EV, so highlights and shadows keep full detail.
map.张数 = 2 × ceil(总范围 / 步长) + 1: Frame count = 2 x ceil(total range / step) + 1
map.由总 EV 范围与步长算所需张数。: Frame count from the total EV range and the step size.
map.核实际覆盖是否够 HDR 合成。: Check whether the actual coverage is enough for HDR blending.
map.：总范围 6EV、步长 1EV：张数 = ceil(6/1)×2+1 = 13: Total range 6 EV with a 1 EV step: frame count = ceil(6/1) x 2 + 1 = 13 frames; the actual coverage is 13 frames x 1 EV, with 6 EV on each side of the middle value.
map.：若只拍 5 张步长 2EV：实际覆盖 8EV，仍不足 10EV 场景，需加张或: Shooting only 5 frames at a 2 EV step covers 8 EV, still short of a 10 EV scene, so add frames or reduce the step.
map.步数需向上取整保证范围被完整覆盖，再加中值 1 张得总张数，避免边缘欠曝。: The number of steps must be rounded up so the range is fully covered, then adding the middle value gives 1 frame for the total, avoiding underexposure at the edges.
map.覆盖 EV 和范围一样吗？: Is covering the EV range the same thing?
map.略多，因首尾各含边界；以实际覆盖校是否包住场景最亮最暗。: Slightly more, because both ends include the boundary; check against the actual coverage whether the brightest and darkest parts of the scene are included.
